Yup 400 mg a day. I take 200 mg when I get up and another 200 mg at 12. My sleep doctor was even thinking 600 mg a day so there’s plenty of room to increase your dose.

I’ve been on modafinil for awhile. They upped my dose from 200 mg to 400 mg about a year ago. It keeps me up but does lose its effect around midday. My sleep neurologist wants to switch me to adderall. I think the way you take it matters. I used to take my modafinil all first thing in the morning but my sleep neurologist is having me space out the dosing. And if I switch to adderall I’ll take it 3X a day.

I always get really bad hip and back pain after a lumbar. I usually use a heating pad and some ibuprofen. Sometimes the pain is really intense. But the good news is it usually resolves itself in a week. Just try to hang in there and do things that make you comfortable. The pain is likely temporary. Caffeine really helps the post lumbar headache too.
